name: Gopa Nayak

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Gopa Nayak writes poetry in English and Odia and translates Odia literature into English. Raised in Bhubaneswar, she pursued postgraduate study at Oxford, earning a DPhil. Her poetry collection Dissension appeared in 2011; her writing brings language, memory and the experience of living across cultures into conversation.

In Kabita Live, ‘Illusion’ asks whether love can be dismissed as unreal when taste, scent and touch make it so vividly present. ‘Shakuntala’ turns to a different kind of remembering: a woman speaks through the roles assigned to her by myth, questioning abandonment and insisting on her own account of motherhood and identity.
